title: AUTH-078 manual Extend installs B and validates B

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context

steps.title: Install clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 07:59:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
Pause clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 08:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And access A is expired; refresh R expires at controlled time T+600 seconds
4. And the dialog named "Your session has been expired" on the Home page is visible
5. And the relogin service accepts refresh R with new access B
6. When User A clicks the button labelled "Extend" inside the dialog named "Your session has been expired"
7. Then the dialog named "Your session has been expired" on the Home page is absent
8. And the browser records exactly 1 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/relogin"
9. And the recovery POST header Single-UI-Refresh equals R
10. When the fixture delivers the accepted recovery response containing access B
11. Then the tab labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is visible

steps.title: One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".

assertionSteps.title: 12. And the installed access credential equals B
13. When the browser sends a controlled validation POST using the installed access credential
14. Then the POST to "/api/auth/v2/sso/validate" has singleUIAuthorization equal to B and returns result=true

annotations.description: Actual MFE; Playwright clock; controlled API responses; unsigned browser-only credentials. No natural lifecycle or BFF expiry claim.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
